name: 24-pegged-boot-poisoned-reference
incident: 2026-08-21 - a galayou_y4_t23n booted with its AE hard-railed (exposure index 131072, 0 units of reserve) and anchored its night reference on the clip
description:
The T23 boot defect, end to end. The ISP comes up with 128 units of digital gain it was never asked for: the exposure index reads the rail (here 262144, the synthetic sensor's rail; 131072 on the device) where the scene is worth a twentieth of that, and the AE has 0 units of reserve - the meter is a clip, not a measurement. Measured on the device: re-asserting running_mode=1 into an ISP that already holds 1 is a no-op (still railed 25 minutes later); what repairs the tuning is one real transition through day and back (12 s after 'day' the index had moved, 12 s after 'night' it read 5720 - factor 23).

Three properties are asserted, and each one failed on the night of 2026-08-20/21:

1. The automaton recognises the railed meter at boot and spends one filter cycle to re-tune it, instead of re-asserting a value that never changed.

2. No clip enters long-term memory. The boot-time silent probe would compare two clips (r=1.00 - the very line before the verdict says the meter is pegged), and on the device the reference then anchored at 131072 with a probe bar of 65536: a twentyfold-too-dark night declared normal. Here the reference must stay unset ('deferred') until the meter is off the rail, and the pre-probe level of the boot cycle - also a clip - must not be ratcheted in by the revert.

3. Once the cycle has repaired the meter, the reference anchors at the honest level and the machinery actually works again: a light switched on at t=600 must reach day via the jump trigger and a silent probe, which a reference of 262144 (bar 131072) would have deferred past any real brightening.

Curve notes: night_gain steps 262144 -> 5720 at t=90, modelling 'the transition the machine is expected to make around t=7..15 repairs the AE'. The step sat at t=30 until 2026-08-22, paired with a scenario-local ref_delay_s=5; the consolidation made the reference delay the fixed DN_REF_DELAY_S=30 and the override silently stopped applying, which moved the anchor attempt from t~19 to t~46 - past the old repair, so property 2's deferral branch was never entered again and the scenario went green while testing nothing. The repair therefore has to land AFTER the anchor comes due: night is re-entered at t~14, the anchor is attempted at t~46 on a still-railed meter (deferral logged), and the reference anchors at ~5.9k once the step lands at t=90. A machine that never cycles reaches the repair only at t=90, long after its own anchor timer comes due at t~30 - so a build without the deferral check anchors the clip and the forbid_log patterns catch it. night_gain_noir stays railed until the light comes on: without the illuminator this yard is pitch dark, which is also why the healthy dark reading of the boot-era probes pegs - a railed DARK reading is legitimate night evidence; the railed LIT reading is what carries no information.

expect_log: boot: AE railed with 0 units of reserve
probe found night, but the pre-probe level
